name: Liberia

flag.description: Eleven horizontal stripes alternating red and white, with a blue square canton in the upper hoist bearing a single white five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: The eleven stripes stand for the signatories of Liberia's Declaration of Independence; the lone star represents Liberia as Africa's first independent republic.

hook: Liberia is the 'Lone Star' flag: US-style red and white stripes but only eleven of them, and a single white star in the blue square.
trivia: Liberia was founded by the American Colonization Society as a home for freed African Americans, and its capital Monrovia is named after US President James Monroe.
Liberia runs one of the world's largest ship registries, so many ocean-going ships fly its flag.
